images.desert_camp: A Bedouin camp of dark woven goat-hair tents in a wide desert valley at golden hour, a few camels resting and a small flock of sheep, date palms, peaceful family life.
images.dream_sky: A magical dreamy sky, half night and half golden dawn, with exactly eleven bright five-pointed stars arranged in one gentle arc, a glowing round sun and a crescent moon together in the same sky, soft clouds, deep blue and gold. The sun and the moon have no faces.
images.evening_path_empty: An empty sandy path at dusk leading away from a camp of dark goat-hair tents toward distant hills, long shadows, quiet and slightly sad atmosphere.
images.seedling_patience: A small green seedling growing out of dry cracked earth, a few raindrops sparkling on its leaves, soft light from above, hopeful and calm.
images.lamp_seasons: A small clay oil lamp glowing at the entrance of a dark goat-hair tent on a rainy evening, raindrops sparkling in the warm light, a feeling of waiting and hope.
images.search_road: A long desert caravan road at dawn with fresh camel hoof prints in the sand, leading toward a far-away green land on the horizon, hopeful mood.
images.old_staff_lamp: Inside a dark goat-hair tent, an old wooden walking staff leaning against the tent pole next to a softly glowing clay oil lamp, cushions arranged in a circle as if a family will gather, warm evening light, calm and dignified.
